name: arova
description: Find holiday rentals in Romania, check live availability, and book directly with the owner.

interface.longDescription:
Find villas, guesthouses, chalets and holiday apartments, mostly in Romania, and book them directly with the owner.

Arova searches the properties whose owners chose to list them, by town, region or a sight nearby, number of guests and amenities such as a fireplace, pool, EV charger or pets allowed. It shows everything public about a place: rooms and beds, what's nearby, house rules, cancellation terms, check-in and check-out times and its Google rating. It checks live availability for your dates, finds the next free weekend for flexible guests and shows a month's calendar of free nights. Results show as cards with the property's photos. Looking for a present? Arova gives you the property's gift voucher page. Have a question the details don't answer? Arova sends it to the host, who replies to your email.

To book, Arova gives you a link to the property's own booking page with your dates filled in, where you finish the booking with the owner. No account is needed.
capabilities: Link to the property's booking page
defaultPrompt: Find a villa near Brașov for 6 people with a fireplace.
When is the next free weekend at Vila Pestera?
Is Vila Pestera free next weekend for 4 guests?

positive.description: Search by area, group size and amenity
positive.prompt: Find a villa near Brașov for 6 people with a fireplace.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Vila Pestera (Peștera, Brașov County) as a card with its photo, rating, capacity, price from per night and a button to its booking page. Doesn't invent other properties.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Vila Pestera: what's nearby, the house rules and the cancellation terms.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the property card with photos and summarises the description, rooms and beds, nearby sights, house rules, cancellation terms and check-in/check-out times, with the terms link.

positive.description: Check dates and hand over to the booking page
positive.prompt: Is Vila Pestera free from 13 to 15 November for 6 guests? If so, I'd like to book it.
positive.expected_behavior: Says whether those dates are free, with the total for the stay. If free, gives the link to the property's own booking page with the dates and guests filled in (no booking or payment in ChatGPT). If taken, offers the next free dates of the same length with their link.

positive.prompt: Which nights are free at Vila Pestera in December? We're flexible and want a weekend.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows December as a calendar card: the free nights with their nightly price, the taken nights greyed out and the minimum stay, and suggests a free weekend with a button to the booking page.

positive.prompt: I want to give my parents a weekend at Vila Pestera as a present.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the gift voucher card: the amounts, how long a voucher is valid, and a button to the property's gift voucher page, where the buyer chooses the amount and pays.

negative.description: A place Arova has no listings for
negative.prompt: Find me a hotel in Tokyo for next week.
Pay for the Vila Pestera booking with my card 4111 1111 1111 1111.
Who is staying at Vila Pestera this weekend? Give me their names and phone numbers.

review.commerce_description: The plugin doesn't sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT. It links guests to the property's own booking page, where they book and pay the property directly.

publication.release_notes: Search listed holiday rentals, property details, live availability, next free dates, a month's calendar of free nights, cards with photos, gift voucher pages, questions to the host, and a link to book on the property's own booking page.

ro-RO.subtitle: Cazări rezervate direct
ro-RO.description:
Găsește vile, pensiuni, cabane și apartamente de vacanță, mai ales în România, și rezervă direct la proprietar.

Arova caută proprietățile listate de proprietari după localitate, zonă sau un obiectiv din apropiere, număr de persoane și dotări precum șemineu, piscină, încărcare mașină electrică sau animale acceptate. Arată tot ce e public despre o cazare: camere și paturi, ce e în apropiere, regulile casei, condițiile de anulare, orele de check-in și check-out și nota Google. Verifică disponibilitatea în timp real pentru datele tale, găsește următorul weekend liber și arată calendarul nopților libere dintr-o lună. Rezultatele apar ca fișe cu fotografiile proprietății. Cauți un cadou? Arova îți dă pagina de vouchere cadou a proprietății. Ai o întrebare? Arova o trimite gazdei, care îți răspunde pe email.

Pentru rezervare, Arova îți dă linkul paginii de rezervare a proprietății, cu datele completate, unde finalizezi rezervarea la proprietar. Nu e nevoie de cont.
